finding.expected: Within TASK-369 authorized scope, make the existing first-party policy supplier parse and bind the actual immutable primary RUN-368-001 and RESULT package schemas using established canonical Runtime structures, with source from nested result.head_sha and required corroborating exact reviewed candidate, evidence/lineage and publication ancestry rather than fabricating a RUN head_sha. Replace the synthetic flat RUN/RESULT fixture with faithful real-shaped positive and malicious negative canonical Git artifacts, including original RUN status ACTIVE/head_sha=null and nested result.head_sha. Show the public first-party attempt for each of the four flows can authenticate the current actual R5 artifact and select its specialized default; reject forged/mismatched source safely. Reconcile the finite activation-state transition so current valid Human/Brain ACTIVE policy remains accepted without trusting an arbitrary status, while conflicting/revoked policy fails closed. Keep exact Human V1 option, no mixed/dual audit, direct-final ingress isolation and bounded source freshness; reuse the two original focused minimum-sufficient-v1 commands, no full-suite and no new task or renewed Human approval. If a substantive consumer blocker remains beyond the authorized scope, report it rather than a fixture-only PASS.
finding.issue: The new first-party activation cannot authenticate the actual already reviewed/published R5 artifact RUN-368-001. Canonical refs/heads/aios/artifacts/RUN-368-001 at f178? is not relevant; exact artifact SHA 356d320a919f0b0df5df254702e0a0c17780e042 stores .ai/transport/run.json with status ACTIVE and head_sha=null, and .ai/transport/result.json with result.head_sha=f4d944474b4450da3d49376b6b034c9f9d413d60 (top-level result.head_sha absent). _canonical_audit_source incorrectly requires run.get('head_sha') == reviewed source AND result.get('head_sha') == reviewed source. The preserved _resolve_underlying_run_view returns the raw RUN view without filling head_sha. Thus both conditions are false and the canonical first-party default rejects before provider invocation for every flow, despite Runtime V001/V002 both passing. Synthetic tests fabricate run.head_sha=source and a flat result.json {'head_sha':source}, so they mask the live contract mismatch. In the same routine, exact equality to the transitional roadmap status HUMAN_APPROVED_CANONICALIZED_LIVE_PRODUCTION_CONFORMANCE_OUTSTANDING makes successful future Human/Brain reconciliation to an ACTIVE status invalidate the producer's own claimed default. Consequently AC1, AC2, AC4 and AC8 cannot be accepted as real canonical production activation; non-fallback and isolated flow semantics may remain valid.
